caption_candidates.text: Fig. 1 Models proposed to illustrate biofilm maturation. A PSM-mediated biofilm maturation model. B Growth-mediated biofilm maturation model
Fig. 2 Schematic diagram illustrating the Staphylococcal accessory gene regulatory (agr) system and its role in producing AIP, which contributes to biofilm formation
Fig. 3 Schematic illustration of biofilm regulatory networks of S. aureus
Fig. 4 Proteins implicated in the different stages of S. aureus biofilm development. A Attachment, (B) Multiplication, (C) Exodus, (D) Maturation, and (E) Dispersal
Fig. 5 The use of nanoparticles such as liposomes and nanoemulsions as antibacterial-delivery systems
Fig. 6 Mechanism of action of quorum-sensing inhibitors
